verdict.rationale: Floot's docs say a project is a real TypeScript/React app that you "can read or export" (floot-docs-33), and export for self-hosting is documented (floot-docs-11). That supports viewing the code and editing it outside the builder, but nothing shows code editing inside the builder itself; the editor page covers only device preview frames (floot-docs-23). Missing for 10: evidence of an in-builder code editor with direct edit/save, file navigation within the builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
